Content_Details: 06_Social_Media_Analytics_Dashboard_with_Python_Scrap
Rajneesh Chaubey (B.Tech Information Technology, ABES Engineering College)
Data Engineering, Natural Language Processing (NLP), Web Scraping & Business Intelligence
An end-to-end analytics platform that automates multi-platform social media scraping, sentiment classification, and visual KPI reporting using Python, NLP, and interactive dashboard frameworks.
Organizations and creators struggle to aggregate fragmented social media metrics across diverse platforms into a unified, actionable intelligence view.
Raw social media posts are heavily unstructured, containing emojis, URLs, slang, and noise requiring rigorous NLP preprocessing pipelines.
Enterprise social listening platforms are cost-prohibitive for small-to-medium teams, necessitating lightweight, modular Python-based solutions.
Automate robust data ingestion across Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Instagram, Reddit, and YouTube using Python scrapers.
Engineer standard data pipelines for text cleaning, hashtag extraction, and engagement rate calculation.
Implement automated sentiment polarity and subjectivity classification using VADER and TextBlob NLP models.
Develop an interactive, web-based dashboard with dynamic filtering, KPI cards, sentiment distribution charts, and platform comparisons.
